title: x8-vm
$comment: The schema root is intentionally NOT closed: cozystack-engine injects its own keys (_cluster, _namespace) into the values of every tenant application, and with additionalProperties:false Helm rejects the values entirely, so the application does not deploy. No platform chart closes its root. Nested objects are closed: the engine puts nothing there. The memory default must match the machine.yaml passport; the catalog checks verify this.

memory.description: Machine memory: an integer number of Mi or Gi, from 128Mi to 512Mi

commands.description: Operator lines typed at start, separated by ;
